defaultNotes: Cutting phase: keep protein high, hit your calorie target most days, and train hard 6 days per week. Weigh cooked meats and cooked carbs. Drink 3–4L of water. Finish resistance sessions with 20–30 minutes of cardio. Choose one exercise option per row and progress load when you can complete the top of the rep range with good form. Rest day is full recovery—walk and sleep well.
